OP_RETRUN testing

IF YOU JUST STARTED UP THE BITCOIN NODE
bitcoin-cli loadwallet "mywallet"

FIND AN UNSPENT OUTPUT
bitcoin-cli listunspent

GENERATE A NEW ADDRESS TO SEND TO
bitcoin-cli getnewaddress

BUILD THE RAW TRANSACTION
bitcoin-cli -regtest createrawtransaction \
'[{"txid":"3ccc731947d6c362cb695a5096c0b17850c53622e50f72926be67f7ab10f8d8b","vout":0}]' \
'{"bcrt1qsyd8742c5lta949ld640peskhc9pjpzzr7e4tw":49.998,"data":"48656c6c6f20576f726c64"}'

SIGN THE TRANSACTION
bitcoin-cli -regtest signrawtransactionwithwallet 02000000018b8d0fb17a7fe66b92720fe52236c55078b1c096505a69cb62c3d6471973cc3c0000000000fdffffff02c0e4022a01000000160014811a7f5558a7d7d2d4bf6eaaf0e616be0a19044200000000000000000d6a0b48656c6c6f20576f726c6400000000

SEND THE TRANSACTION
bitcoin-cli -regtest sendrawtransaction 

VIEW THE TRANSACTION IN THE MEMPOOL
bitcoin-cli -regtest getrawtransaction 0a4a4bf1e308f3e3c8f70cba7ac6380014d23ba3ba72c1a4840b9f282ccb8e93 true

MINE THE NEXT BLOCK
bitcoin-cli -generate 1

VIEW THE TRANSACTION IN THE BLOCK
bitcoin-cli -regtest getblock 0c093accff29868b08ab6f206b38ed2e759dd0813809adcfb3f830a36a53cce3
